metadata.timingSource: GitHub REST jobs timestamps; connector omits timing fields. Skipped jobs have no runner and sometimes negative timestamp differences, which are not counted as execution.
metadata.limitation: GitHub renders skipped conditional job names as raw expressions. They are distinct from exact required code check names; no application workload ran.
